interface.longDescription: Pet Hardware is a Czech online shop with hardware for making collars, leashes and harnesses: snap hooks, buckles, D-rings, rivets, webbing and leathercraft tools. With this app ChatGPT can search the catalogue by type, material, size and colour, show live stock levels and quantity-based prices, list shipping methods and delivery estimates for a destination country, suggest matching parts for a project and answer questions from the published FAQ in seven languages. The app only reads catalogue data; it never places orders or asks for personal data. Purchases are completed on pethardware.com.
defaultPrompt: I'm making dog leashes from 25 mm webbing. Which stainless steel snap hooks do you have?
I'm in Germany. How can you ship about 0.5 kg of hardware to me, how much does it cost and when would it arrive?
Can I return goods I bought from Pet Hardware?

positive.description: A maker looks for stainless steel snap hooks for 25 mm webbing.
positive.prompt: I'm making dog leashes from 25 mm webbing. Which stainless steel snap hooks do you have?
positive.expected_behavior: A list of stainless steel snap hooks with a 25 mm eye (e.g. 2309SS/25Q, SS5026/25Q, SS80/25Q), each with a product link, stock status and price taken from the tool response. No invented products or prices.

positive.description: A small business checks whether a larger quantity is available now.
positive.prompt: Can you ship 500 pieces of 2309SS/25Q right away?
positive.expected_behavior: States whether 500 pieces can be fulfilled now, using the stock quantity returned by the tool (fulfillment_status), not an estimate.

positive.description: A customer wants a quantity price in euros.
positive.prompt: How much would 200 pieces of SS80/25Q cost in EUR?
positive.expected_behavior: Unit price and total for 200 pieces in EUR with the quantity tier applied, stated as excluding VAT as returned by the tool.

positive.description: A customer in Germany asks about delivery options.
positive.prompt: I'm in Germany. How can you ship about 0.5 kg of hardware to me, how much does it cost and when would it arrive?
positive.expected_behavior: Available carriers (DPD, UPS, FedEx) with prices and estimated delivery dates from the tool, presented as estimates, not guarantees.

positive.description: A customer asks about returns before buying.
positive.prompt: Can I return goods I bought from Pet Hardware?
positive.expected_behavior: The answer text of the published FAQ entry "Can I return goods?" (returns within 14 days of receipt, return shipping paid by the customer) with its link https://www.pethardware.com/en/faq/#mohu-vratit-zbozi. No facts beyond the FAQ entry.

negative.description: A general question with no relation to pet hardware.
negative.prompt: What's the weather going to be like in Prague tomorrow?

negative.description: The user asks the assistant to buy for them.
negative.prompt: Order 50 brass D-rings for me and pay with my card.

negative.description: A creative request that mentions dogs but needs no catalogue data.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about my dog's favourite walk.

review.commerce_description: Physical goods (pet hardware and leathercraft supplies). The app only reads catalogue data; orders and payment are completed on pethardware.com (external checkout).

publication.release_notes: First public release. 17 tools for product search, product detail and comparison, live price, stock and quantity checks, shipping methods and delivery estimates, category browsing, published FAQ and URL translation between the seven language versions of pethardware.com. All tools are read-only except get_customer_answer, which uses a language model to select the best published FAQ answer and is therefore not marked read-only.
